content.title: Home & Kitchen | Costco
content.text: Find the Best Cookware & Bakeware at Costco!Having the right cookware & bakeware is essential for creating delicious home-cooked meals, which is why Costco offers a large inventory of premium roasting pots, saucepans, and pots and pans sets, as well as incredible baking pots. Choose from leading brands like Le Creuset, Calphalon and All-Clad. Great cooking also requires high-quality cutlery. Enjoy impressive savings on professional chef knives, paring knives, and complete cutlery sets from manufacturers like Zwilling J.A. Henckels. And if you’re looking for small kitchen appliances, we have those too! Maximize Efficiency with Clever Kitchen StorageKeep your kitchen functioning efficiently with kitchen storage & organization items from Costco. We have professional slide-out shelves, drawer organizers, and stainless steel garbage cans with automatic lids. And to help you stay organized, Costco offers plenty of food storage containers, cutting boards, and handy storage bins for your refrigerator or pantry cabinets. Create a Beautiful Dining TableSet an inviting dining table with beautiful tableware from Costco. Pair your dishware with a stylish flatware set, high-quality steak knives, or serveware like covered casserole dishes and serving trays. For glassware, we have elegant wine glasses, tumblers, and gorgeous crystal decanters. If you love to entertain, consider purchasing a wine opener or a set of stylish bar tools. And for every day, we have glassware sets and insulated water bottles. Discover Luxurious Bed & Bath IdeasTransform your bedroom into your own personal oasis with luxurious bedding from Costco. You’ll find soft quilts and blankets, designer comforter sets, duvet covers and coverlets in an array of styles. Add an extra layer of comfort to your bed, with a memory foam mattress topper or heated mattress pad. Enjoy high thread-count bed sheets in silky sateen, comfy flannel, or organic cotton. We also carry memory foam pillows, wedge pillows, and the popular MyPillow. Create the feeling of a high-end spa, with great bathroom ideas from Costco. Pamper yourself with oversized bath towels, plush bathroom rugs, or a cozy towel warmer. You’ll find organic cotton towels that are gentle on the skin, and sumptuous Turkish towel sets with superior absorbency. And for bathroom décor, we have bathroom mirrors and numerous bathroom accessories. Add Style to any Space with Home DecorFind stylish bedroom and living room ideas with home décor items from Costco. Our inventory includes candle holders, wall clocks, bedside lamps, and decorative throw pillows. Find attractive display and storage ideas, like floating shelves and storage cubes. For window coverings, you’ll find living room and bedroom curtains in sheer or blackout styles. If you’re looking to add color and texture to a room, we have gorgeous area rugs and living room rugs. For high traffic areas, we have stain-resistant kitchen rugs and durable indoor/outdoor rugs. And if you’d like to keep your newly decorated home fresh and clean, we have powerful vacuum and floor cleaners from top brands like Shark, Bissell, and Dyson. Get Creative with Premium Sewing Machines & Garment Care ItemsWhether you’re interested in tailoring trousers or monogramming a shirt, Costco has excellent embroidery and sewing machines to handle the job. Enjoy convenient features like built-in stitches and patterns, and special quilting functions. Choose from quality brands like Janome and Brother. We also have garment care items like irons and fabric steamers, so you can eliminate unsightly wrinkles and creases without having to spend time and money at the drycleaners. When you shop this special category, you’ll get the opportunity to view and purchase products from some of our top supplier’s sites—while still benefiting from exclusive Costco member pricing. With Costco Next, you’ll enjoy a wider selection of premium and high-end items—from luxury bedding and designer rugs, to sought-after kitchen appliances and the hottest trends in home décor. Shop Costco Next, and find an unexpected treasure round every corner!
